text:
A Frost Advisory is in effect for Burlington tonight through 7 tomorrow morning. If you’re heading out today, the sun will help, but it won’t feel warm, with a high right around 55 and a stiff northwest breeze. The lake is no easy escape, either, with west winds 15 to 20 knots easing later, waves around 1 to 3 feet, and water still just 59. Bundle up for a walk, and keep the tender plants covered tonight as skies clear and temperatures slip to around 38.

Wednesday brings a milder feel, but the forecast has some spread, with the models ranging from the low 60s to the upper 60s. I’d split the difference near 63, with clouds, a south wind gusting close to 28, and a 30% chance of a brief shower between 9 and 1. Plan outdoor time today, and wait until Wednesday afternoon for the calmer lake conditions, when waves should build to 3 to 5 feet.

week.blurb: Sunny and brisk, with a high near 55, a good day for a jacket and outdoor plans.
Clouds, wind, and a few showers shape Wednesday, with a high near 63 and the rain mainly before lunch.
Thursday turns milder near 65, with showers possible and a stray thunderstorm, especially through the afternoon.
Mostly sunny Friday reaches 59, with only a slight shower chance late, so outdoor plans look solid.
Saturday stays mostly sunny near 58, a crisp, comfortable day for outdoor plans.
Sunday looks sunny and warmer near 66, though south winds pick up, so secure anything light outdoors.
Columbus Day stays partly sunny near 66, with a slight shower chance after 2pm, so keep plans flexible late.
